info.name: Fleet Control
info.description:
Comprehensive E2E Postman collection for Fleet Control microservices (Gateway, Auth, Vehicles, Drivers, Routes).

Features:
- Organised in 5 modules: Gateway, Auth, Vehicles, Drivers, Routes
- Automatic token capture in 'Auth > Login (saves jwtToken)' both in environment and collection variables
- Automatic ID capture (vehicleId, driverId, routeId) in creation requests
- 'Validate token' endpoints connect directly to ms-auth (:8081) with X-Internal-Key as required by security architecture
- Dynamic generators for emails/plates/licenses to support repeated full runs (Newman / Collection Runner) without 409 collisions
- Full coverage of positive flows, filtering, validations (400), conflicts (409), not found (404), invalid state transitions (409), and missing authentication (401).
